metric: English METEOR using NLTK 3.9.2 alignment, its Porter stemmer and WordNet 3.0.
semantic_reference: Whitespace-separated Unicode words with lowercasing; exact, stem and single-token lexical matches, followed by fragmentation penalty. Cloud tokenization and exact grader scores are not published.
dependencies: The program and corpus are embedded. Only the existing disposable CPython 3.12 worker loads and grades user text. The serving process does not import NLTK or access a remote lexical service.

An isolated dictionary lookup with an uppercase input differed from the independent reader. The lowercase lookup is now explicit; the rerun compared the same words and scores.
